question.prompt: \(\frac{6}{7}\) of a sheet of paper is divided into equal portions, each \(\frac{2}{7}\) of a sheet. How many portions can be made? Calculate: \((\frac{6}{7}) \div (\frac{2}{7}) = ?\)

solutions.explanation: Each portion uses two of the six available sevenths. Grouping them in pairs gives \(6 \div 2 = 3\) portions, using all the paper. Thus \(\frac{6}{7} \div \frac{2}{7} = 3\).
solutions.title: Group the sevenths
